zh-CN.title: 新用户引导与桌面布局优化
items: 修复新用户桌面聊天列表沉底的问题，并优化深色模式下的邮箱认证提示
广场始终显示发言入口，未认证用户点击后会收到清晰的认证引导

en.title: Improved onboarding and desktop layout
items: Fixed desktop chat lists appearing at the bottom for new users and improved the email verification banner in dark mode
The Square post action now remains visible and guides unverified users through verification when selected
